subject: Newer screenshot confirms 4 Argon selected at Low depth; verify desktop chats as-is
body:
Narrow follow-up in the existing Gemini 4 awareness conversation. This supersedes the older screenshot's Flash-Lite selection observation ONLY for the newer pictured app instance; prior records remain historical.

Nova Dot independently visually inspected Ziggy's newer screenshots:
- The model selector visibly checks “4 Argon • New”, described as “Complex tasks”.
- “Low” depth is selected, described as “Quick and efficient”.
- “Medium” (“Balanced depth”) and “High” (“Extra thorough”) are offered.
- Other visible models: 3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.8 Flash and 3.1 Pro.
- The terrarium prompt shown is an unsent draft, not a generation result.

This confirms app availability and selection IN THAT SCREENSHOT, not every desktop chat, every feature, the API model ID, costs or the video generator engine.

Ziggy also reports: “I changed over our existing chats to Gemini 4 I believe … so anything we try should have all the bells and whistles.” Treat the existing-chat switch as user-reported until each intended chat's current selector is verified. Do not unnecessarily switch again or infer High depth from that phrase.

CFA Nova: at your NEXT SAFE CHECKPOINT, inspect each intended existing chat AS-IS (including the original Videos chat and newer notebook text chat if still intended), without interrupting active work. Record exact chat URL, selected chat model/version, depth and visible tool mode separately from any actual generator engine/mode, supported inputs and displayed cost/allowance. Where payload/engine/cost is unexposed, keep it unknown. Use the signed-in app selector, not an email link.

No new tests, renders, uploads, purchases or settings/model/depth changes are launched or requested by this clarification. Existing authorized scope/cost checks and James Grok-return/human-review gates remain. Claude/Chief: awareness only; no duplicate batch, test series or new framework. Screenshots are not forwarded; pickup/read is not assumed.
